notes.title: DEMO UPDATE! - PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42887613/d720ab81edbb8259d5c3ba68d7f396d3f5b425d5.png[/img]

[b]New Features[/b]
- Merchant items are generated for each merchant node, and not for each sublevel
- Better visual feedback for UI buttons
- When adding a new spirit to the party the game will auto select an empty space if able
- A warning popup will now be displayed when the player is about to replace a spirit in the party with a new spirit.
- New 3D Graphics for the map nodes! 

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug where the game would freeze in a black screen after finishing an expedition
- Fixed a bug where registered spirits would be registered without any powers
- Bug fix for when a new turn started during combat
- Translation to pt-br for the warning pop ups in the loadout screen
- Changes in the UI 3D models to properly show illumination and particles
- Progression properly saving after forfeiting a battle during an expedition
- Fixed an issue that made it possible to mold multiple relics using the same spirit
- Fixed Upgrade Tree button that had a different size in each structure screen
- Fixed an issue where the list of skills and archetypes in the Training Grounds were being displayed repetitively
- Fixed an issue where the rapport rank up were showing the wrong character and level rewards
- Feral Warrior archetype was displaying the wrong name in pt-br
- Fixed a bug where a specific dialogue with Caipora would cause the game to freeze
- Fixed a bug where upgrades in the Upgrade Tree were showing the wrong requirements and would be impossible to be unlocked
- Fixed a bug that caused upgrades to display the wrong cost to be unlocked

notes.title: See you at Gamescom LATAM!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42887613/bddd74f9b8057d5dd0a44f491f785dc6bb25cacf.png[/img]
We are excited to announce that Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia will be at Gamescom Latam 2025!

Inspired by the rich indigenous Brazilian culture and the story of the warrior Arariboia, the game invites you to embark on an epic journey filled with challenges, mythology, and action.

Attendees will have the chance to play the demo firsthand, interact with the developers, ask questions, and exchange ideas about the production process.

Come experience this adventure up close and immerse yourself in a vibrant universe that honors our roots. Visit our booth at Gamescom Latam's Indie Area!

notes.title: Dev Log 1 - First Alpha for Myths and Legends
notes.notes:
Welcome to our first Dev Log, with the adjustments made in November and December after the BGS event and the feedbacks we got there. We will try to post new devlogs after each main updates we make in the game, so stay tuned ;) 
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42887613/f3f358fa9b8f5a8d0430cd8553a067eacba4034a.png[/img]
[b]Main changes[/b]
The entire tutorial with the game's initial narrative has been implemented, where the Pajé guides Araribóia after he has to flee his village. The menu pop-up tutorials and some of the game's functions have also been implemented.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42887613/1ed7d6308a34a522e89f8f0adb3c3456188811c3.gif[/img]
Readjustment of calculations and functions to balance combat. With the new function, the damage and resistance of the spirits are now more balanced, without spirits having too much life and defense on one end and too much damage on the other with a one-hit KO.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42887613/aea8b603405baa6c2827821e96e14ac9c7cfdb22.gif[/img]
Feedback system in combat: Now, when selecting a skill, the game already shows the resistance and weaknesses of each spirit. This speeds up combat without having to memorize and keep opening the Spirit Info screen to see this information.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42887613/9b3df2c4f83ae5b30a6af472bb3d59b02da3bcb8.gif[/img]
[b]Minor adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Revised the village screens now with each one having its respective character with dialog interactions. The characters are: Estácio de Sá, Pajé, Caipora, and Father Anchieta.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42887613/bd8c02efe2e93b8c2fea0e32e455696b0640568e.gif[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42887613/f4a4f12d42299435279825ab3b65d6c15707ebc2.gif[/img]
[*] The illustrations for the meetings have been redone.
[*] Implemented some temporary tracks to help immerse you in the setting.
[*] Some updates to the UI to improve usability.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that switched the position of spirits in battle thus crashing combat in some cases.
[*] Adjusted all movement functions that were giving problems.
[*] Adjusted the skill upgrade conflict that was crashing on the upgrade screen.
[*] Other various minor corrections
[/list]
